items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Irv Goodman sent them to me

ctx.x: something about Lester: Let me ask you^A It's funny, I've got Lester on tapes and anytime I go out to the supermarket or anything, I shove my tape on and I am listening to Lester all the time. It just so happens that I have those at this time, and I will be just living with Lester daily, as I go in and out. It just so happens that I have those tapes.^A And Irv Goodman sent them to me and I have been playing them all the time.

And I've been thinking -- you know how it is when you hear something over and over and I have been thinking to myself about Lester. It seems to me that the gift that Lester had and what Lester does and it's what you had said in a way, what he's doing all the time is singing music and he's not selling sound. It isn't how he's presenting it and it isn't the total effect of what he's presenting, although it's there in almost a negative way, you might say, but it's the way his musical imagination and creativity and…
